texts.Mirror_Access_RetiredSetInactive: {0} is inactive and holds the {1} permission set, so BarnCRM did not give them {2}. They keep {1}; if they are reactivated, the hourly access check gives them {2}. Nothing to do now.
texts.Mirror_AccountingExport_ChangedSinceDown: Gifts in this range changed since you downloaded the file, so nothing was marked. Click Download File again, import the new file, and then click Mark These Gifts Posted.
texts.Mirror_AccountingExport_Intro: Download the gifts in a date range as a spreadsheet for your accounting system: one row for each fund a gift went to, and refunds as negative rows on the day the money went back.
texts.Mirror_AccountingExport_MarkPostedHelp: Once this file is in your accounting system, mark its gifts posted. A posted gift cannot be changed or deleted.
texts.Mirror_AccountingExport_Visibility: The file holds the gifts you can see. If gifts in your organization are private, the person who runs the export needs to see all of them.
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_Intro: Each appeal gets a matching Salesforce Campaign, kept current as the appeal changes, so Campaign Members and marketing tools work. Nothing is copied back, and no Campaign is ever deleted.
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_LogNoAccess: Campaign sync skipped {0} appeal(s): the person who saved them cannot create and edit Campaigns, or lacks the Salesforce Records Sync permission set. Click Sync All Appeals on the Campaign Sync page to catch them up.
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_LogNoHeadroom: Campaign sync did not copy the appeals in a very large save, because copying them in the same transaction would pass Salesforce limits. The appeals are saved without their Campaigns. Click Sync All Appeals on the Campaign Sync page to give them their Campaigns.
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_LogOrphan: Sync All Appeals created the Campaign {0} for the appeal "{1}", but could not store its Campaign ID on the appeal or delete the Campaign again: {2} Delete that Campaign, or paste its ID onto the appeal once it can be saved.
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_LogRunSummary: Sync All Appeals, pass {0} of 2: {1} Campaigns created, {2} updated, {3} already up to date, {4} could not be copied (each has its own Warning).
texts.Mirror_CampaignSync_Running: Sync All Appeals is running in the background. Reload this page in a minute to see new counts. Anything that could not be copied is in the Error Log.
texts.Mirror_GiftTransactionMirror_Intro: Gives each received gift a matching Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction, with its designations, so Nonprofit Cloud's donor summaries count the gifts you enter in BarnCRM. Run Now copies what is waiting. The nightly run catches up at 1:35 AM, in the time zone of the person who scheduled BarnCRM Nightly Jobs.
texts.Mirror_GiftTransactionMirror_Reconciliat: Compare the received gifts dated in a range with the Gift Transactions of the paid status dated in it, as you can see them.
texts.Mirror_HealthCheck_MirrorNotRunDetail: The Opportunity mirror's nightly run is scheduled, but none has completed since {0}. It runs as the person who scheduled it, so if they were deactivated or lost access every run fails. In BarnCRM Settings, open Opportunity mirror, stop the nightly run, and schedule it again as someone who can run it. The Error Log says why runs failed.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_AmountNotAboveZ: The Opportunity has no amount above zero, so no gift was made from it.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ContactRole: The Opportunity was written, but its primary contact role could not be: {0}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_CopyAgainGiftsO: Copy These Gifts Again works only in Gifts to Opportunities: a gift is never changed from its Opportunity.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_DeletedKept: Its Opportunity is left in place. Delete it, or close it as lost, yourself if it should go.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_DeletedRemade: Its Opportunity is left in place, and while it is won the next run makes a new gift from it. Close it as lost, or delete it, to keep the gift gone.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_DifferenceCount: Differences found: {0}. The first {1} are listed.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_DirectionGifts: Direction: Gifts to Opportunities. Every gift in the totals gets a matching Opportunity.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_DirectionOpport: Direction: Opportunities to Gifts. Won Opportunities closed on or after {0} become gifts.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ErrorDateOrder: The start date must be on or before the end date.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ErrorDatesRequi: Choose a start date and an end date.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ErrorFailed: Something went wrong. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ErrorTooMany: This range holds more than 10,000 gifts or more than 10,000 won Opportunities, or more records than one comparison can read. Choose a shorter range.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_Intro: Keeps gifts and Salesforce Opportunities in step, in the direction set in BarnCRM Settings. Run now copies what is waiting. The nightly run catches up at 1:30 AM, in the time zone of the person who scheduled BarnCRM Nightly Jobs.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_InvalidOpportun: Opportunity ID must be the record ID of an Opportunity (18 characters, starting 006), or empty.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogDeletedMany: {0} gifts linked to Opportunities were deleted ({1}). {2}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogDeletedOne: The gift {0}, linked to an Opportunity, was deleted. {1}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogMany: The Opportunity mirror could not copy {0} gifts ({1}): {2}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogManyOpportun: The Opportunity mirror could not make gifts from {0} Opportunities ({1}): {2}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogNoAccess: The Opportunity mirror skipped {0} gift(s) because the person who saved them cannot create and edit Opportunities. The next run copies them, and any later change to a gift that has one.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogNoHeadroom: The Opportunity mirror did not copy the gifts in a very large save, because copying them in the same transaction would pass Salesforce limits. The gifts are saved without Opportunities, and the next mirror run copies them.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogOne: The Opportunity mirror could not copy the gift {0}: {1}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogOneOpportuni: The Opportunity mirror could not make a gift from the Opportunity {0}: {1}
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogOrphan: The Opportunity mirror created the Opportunity {0} for this gift, but could not store its Opportunity ID on the gift or delete the Opportunity again: {1} Delete that Opportunity, or paste its ID onto the gift once it can be saved.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogRunGifts: Opportunity mirror run, Opportunities to Gifts: {0} gifts made, {2} Opportunities already had a gift, {3} could not become gifts (see the Warnings), {4} left for the next run.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_LogRunOpportuni: Opportunity mirror run, Gifts to Opportunities: {0} Opportunities created, {1} updated, {2} already up to date, {3} could not be copied (see Warnings), {4} left for the next run.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_MasterRecordTyp: The Opportunity mirror's record type list includes Master. An Opportunity without a record type stores none, so Master matches nothing and the run skipped it. Remove Master from the list in the Opportunity mirror settings, or leave the list empty to include every Opportunity.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_Missing: The Opportunity linked to the gift was deleted or is not visible to you. If deleted, clear the gift's Opportunity ID to make a new Opportunity. If it still exists, give the person saving the gift access to it.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoDonor: The Opportunity has no primary contact or account, so no gift was made from it. Give it a primary contact or an account, and the next run makes the gift.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoLinkAccess: Comparing needs the Salesforce Records Sync permission set, which lets you read the Opportunity ID on a gift.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoManagePermiss: Starting or scheduling the mirror needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoOpportunityAc: You cannot create and edit Opportunities, or you do not have the Salesforce Records Sync permission set, so a run started by you would copy nothing.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoOpportunityRe: Comparing needs read access to Opportunities and to their Name, Amount and Close Date. Ask your BarnCRM admin for it.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoStage: Salesforce has no active closed stage of the kind this gift needs (won for a gift in the totals, lost for a Cancelled one), so its Opportunity could not be written. In Setup, activate a Closed Won and a Closed Lost stage.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoStartDate: Direction: Opportunities to Gifts, but no start date is set, so no Opportunity becomes a gift. Set Opportunity mirror start date in BarnCRM Settings.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NoUsePermission: The Opportunity mirror page needs the Salesforce Records Sync permission set. Ask your BarnCRM admin for it.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_NotScheduled: The nightly run is not scheduled.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_ReconciliationI: Compare the gifts in the totals dated in a range with the won Opportunities closed in it, as you can see them.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_RunPaused: The Opportunity mirror run did nothing, because automation is paused on the Automation page. The next run after it resumes catches up.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_RunSwitchedOff: The Opportunity mirror run did nothing, because the Opportunity mirror is switched off on the Automation page. Switch it on for its runs to work again.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_Running: A run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_Started: The run has started. Its summary is written to the Error Log when it ends.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_SwitchedOff: The Opportunity mirror is off. Choose a direction in BarnCRM Settings, Giving, Opportunity mirror direction.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_Unavailable: This org has no Opportunities, so there is nothing to mirror. The Opportunity mirror needs an edition with Opportunities, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, NPSP or Nonprofit Cloud.
texts.Mirror_OpportunityMirror_UnknownRecordTy: The Opportunity mirror's record type list names types this org does not have: {0}. They match no Opportunity, so no gift is made from them. Correct the list in the Opportunity mirror settings.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_CampaignSync_Steps: Click the permission set those people have (or open Profiles for their profile).|Click Object Settings, then Campaigns, then Edit.|Tick Read, Create and Edit, then click Save.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_CampaignSync_What: Let the people who create appeals create and edit Campaigns, through their profile or a permission set. Give yourself Salesforce Records Sync on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_CampaignSync_Why: A Campaign is created with the access of the person saving the appeal; without it the appeal still saves, and Sync all appeals catches it up.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_GiftTransactionMirror_S: Click Fundraising User (or the permission set your org uses for Nonprofit Cloud fundraising).|Click Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.|Tick the people who run the mirror, then click Assign.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_GiftTransactionMirror_W: Whoever runs or schedules the Gift Transaction mirror needs Nonprofit Cloud's Fundraising User permission set, so they can create and edit Gift Transactions and their designations. Give yourself Salesforce Records Sync on the Access page.
Each run writes with the access of the person who started or scheduled it; without it the run copies nothing and says why in the Error Log.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_MarketingUser_Steps: Click Edit next to the person.|Tick Marketing User.|Click Save.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_MarketingUser_What: Tick Marketing User on the user of each person who creates appeals.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_MarketingUser_Why: Salesforce lets only a Marketing User create Campaigns, and that box is on the user in Setup.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_Mirror_Steps: Click the permission set your fundraising staff have (or open Profiles for their profile).|Click Object Settings, then Opportunities, then Edit.|Tick Read, Create and Edit, then click Save.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_Mirror_What: To give each gift its Opportunity at once, let fundraising staff create and edit Opportunities through their profile or a permission set. Give yourself Salesforce Records Sync on the Access page.
texts.Mirror_SetupNote_Mirror_Why: Opportunities are written with the access of the person saving the gift; without it the nightly run catches them up instead.
texts.Mirror_Sync_OtherMessages: Refused for other reasons, too many different ones to list one by one. Save one of these records by hand to see why it was refused.
